blurb:
Private Tour - Explore the breathtaking beauty of Santa Barbara and its Wine Country in an upscale Mercedes Sprinter van or similar on this unforgettable experience departing from Los Angeles. 

Customize your adventure on this full-day experience, featuring a unique blend of sights that highlight the beauty and charm of California’s Central Coast.

 - Discover the charm of Solvang, a quaint Danish-inspired village filled with fairytale architecture, windmills, authentic Danish bakeries, wine-tasting rooms, and delightful shops.
- Savor award-winning wines at a family-friendly winery, surrounded by rolling hills and scenic vineyards. 
- Visit Los Olivos, a charming, historic town with over 25 tasting rooms within 3 village blocks. 
- Experience Santa Barbara, “America’s Riviera”, Spanish Colonial architecture, palm-lined streets, and sweeping ocean views.

Customize by substituting village stops with winery stops, instead. 

Wine/Lunch NOT included. 
Children & Dogs Welcome.
